questions.prompt: Moving into a higher tax bracket means:
choices: All your income is taxed at the higher rate
Only income within that bracket is taxed at the higher rate
You pay no tax below it
Your effective rate equals your marginal rate
questions.rationale: Only the slice of income inside the higher bracket is taxed at that rate.
A credit reduces tax directly; a deduction only reduces taxable income.

questions.prompt: In one line, when is a capital gain typically taxed?
questions.model_answer: When the asset is sold (the gain is 'realised').
questions.rationale: Most systems tax gains on realisation, not while unrealised.
